title: TREAD UPON THE ENEMY
GOD'S PROMISE OF PROTECTION
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering
stock_queries: ancient stone watchtower sunlit mountain pass
sunbeam through dark clouds over river
golden light mountain path pine trees
calm river flowing through mountain gorge
rocky mountain peak under sunrise sky
ancient stone fortress wall sun rays

scenes.a: Fear of hidden danger surrounds your steps today.
Hear the promise of Christ in Luke 10:19:
scenes.sub: GOD GIVES POWER OVER THE ENEMY

scenes.a: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
Lord, cover every path we walk and grant us spiritual authority over unseen threats that seek to bring harm.
scenes.sub: COVERING EVERY STEP OF THE PATH

scenes.a: Protect our going out and coming in, crushing every subtle snare beneath Your holy feet.
We rest securely under Your sovereign hand, trusting that no enemy weapon can prevail.
Amen. We step forward safely, even when fear of hidden danger surrounds our steps.
